about.title: DevOps Engineer & Software Developer
about.summary: DevOps and Software Engineer with around 4 years building and operating CI/CD pipelines, AWS cloud infrastructure, and full-stack applications. Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform, and Ansible to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments.
paragraphs: I operate AWS environments end-to-end — from provisioning infrastructure with Terraform to running containerized microservices on Kubernetes and keeping production healthy with Prometheus and Grafana.

On the development side, I build backend services and web applications with PHP, Python, and MySQL, and ship features using Node.js and React.js, often leveraging AI-assisted workflows to move faster without sacrificing quality.
I enjoy the space where development and operations meet: designing CI/CD pipelines that make deployments boring, predictable, and safe.

highlights: Operated 3 AWS environments (Staging, UAT, Production) with EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, ECS, Lambda, CloudFront, SQS, CloudWatch.
Built automated CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Azure Repos, and SonarQube quality gates.
Led containerization and Kubernetes rollout for monolith-to-microservices migration.
Engineered high-efficiency query validation logic improving system accuracy by 90%.

experience.summary: Own CI/CD pipelines, AWS infrastructure across three environments, and full-stack feature delivery for a monolith-to-microservices migration.
responsibilities: Built and managed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, integrated with Azure Repos for version control and SonarQube for automated code quality gating, reducing failed deployments and improving release reliability.

Operated AWS cloud environments (Staging, UAT, Production) using EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, ECS, Lambda, SQS, CloudFront, and CloudWatch, maintaining secure and highly available infrastructure across environments.
Automated deployments for monolithic applications in staging using Jenkins, Ansible, and Python scripting, reducing manual release effort.
Deployed and managed microservices in UAT using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, handling cluster management, scaling, and service discovery.
Monitored production systems using Prometheus and Grafana, handled incidents, and optimized performance to maintain high availability and system reliability.
Provisioned infrastructure for new client environments using Terraform, ensuring repeatable and consistent deployments, reducing setup time by 80%.
Implemented high-efficiency query validation and correction logic, improving system accuracy by 90%.

Participated in the end-to-end migration of a monolithic application to a microservices architecture, containerizing services with Docker and deploying them on Kubernetes to improve scalability and deployment independence.
Migrated legacy application codebase to the updated microservices version, coordinating with the development workflow to ensure continuity of functionality and minimal disruption during cutover.
Built and maintained backend services and web-application infrastructure using PHP, Python, and MySQL on Apache, supporting reliable, version-controlled releases alongside infrastructure work.
Built and enhanced application features using Node.js and React.js, leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate iteration, improve code quality, and reduce delivery time.

projects.title: Automated CI/CD & Terraform Infrastructure Pipeline
projects.description: Architected an automated infrastructure provisioning and continuous integration pipeline utilizing Terraform, Jenkins, and Azure Repos with SonarQube quality validation.
projects.deepDive: Configured modular Terraform state backends on AWS S3 with DynamoDB locking. Integrated Jenkins multi-branch pipelines executing automated linting, unit testing, and SonarQube security gating prior to automated deployment to staging and production.
projects.impact: Slashed client environment setup time by 80% with repeatable IaC.

projects.title: Monolith to Microservices Kubernetes Migration
projects.description: Participated end-to-end in migrating a monolithic application to a microservices architecture — containerizing services with Docker and deploying to Kubernetes on AWS.
projects.deepDive: Authored optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles reducing image size by 65%. Designed Kubernetes Deployment manifests, Ingress controllers, horizontal pod autoscalers (HPA), and config maps with rolling deployment strategies.
projects.impact: Decoupled deployment lifecycles and enabled zero-disruption legacy cutover.

projects.title: Production Monitoring & Observability Grid
projects.description: Set up Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for production systems, enabling proactive incident detection and performance optimization to maintain high availability.
projects.deepDive: Metrics scraped by Prometheus across services, visualized in Grafana dashboards with alerting for anomaly detection across container nodes, database clusters, and web servers.
projects.impact: Maintained 99.9% high availability through proactive incident detection.

projects.title: High-Efficiency SQL Query Validation Engine
projects.description: Implemented query validation and correction logic for a PHP/MySQL backend on Apache, improving system accuracy by 90%.
projects.deepDive: Backend validation layer intercepts and corrects malformed queries before execution against MySQL, with logging for auditability and reduced downstream data errors.
projects.impact: Improved backend system accuracy by 90% and eliminated downstream data errors.

projects.title: React & Node.js Feature Development
projects.description: Built and enhanced application features using Node.js and React.js, leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate iteration and improve code quality.
projects.deepDive: Component-driven React frontend consuming REST APIs backed by Node.js services with clean state management and rapid iteration cycles.
projects.impact: Delivered faster feature rollouts through consistent review and AI-assisted workflows.
